title: The Pale Archive
author: Kestrel Nystrom
blurb: Lena Ashgrove, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
